_note: Commission 10% (LATRA allows 10-20%). VAT 18% on platform revenue. LATRA levy 1% of the fare (order: 0.5-1%), borne by the platform so the rider's fare stays inside LATRA's caps. No booking fee: LATRA's fare order lists none. Pickup waiting fee capped at 3% of the fare (LATRA order: waiting fee up to 3%). Fares are rounded to the nearest 50 TZS. Free cancel for 2 minutes after a driver accepts; no-show after 5 minutes waiting; the driver gets 80% of a cancellation fee. Driver debt: a driver is put on hold at 5,000 TZS owed, or after 7 days owing 1,000 TZS or more; the smallest mobile-money payment is 1,000 TZS (the gateway minimum), so nobody is held for less than they can pay.
